hook: 粗 means rough or coarse: "Ah, rough!" (あら) you groan when you spot the flaw.
A mountain (山) over a stone (石): a big rock. "Ee-wah, heavy!"
"Ooh, saggy" ears? No, a rabbit's long ears stand straight up: うさぎ.
Tree (木) radical: the stump left of a tree; new shoots grow from it, like stocks in a company.
Power (力) radical: you just "can" (かん) feel it, your sixth sense.
A cover (冖) over a vehicle (車): war chariots, an army with "guns" (ぐん).
Flesh (月) radical: your side, where your arms hang. "Walk-ee" at someone's side (わき).
Clothing (衤) radical: the part of clothes your arm comes out of. "So, then" (そで), roll up your sleeves.
Water runs between two hills to make a valley; "Tanny" hikes down into the たに.
A political party: all members "tow" (とう) the same party line.
"Doc!" (どく), I drank poison!
Words (言) + lost (迷): words that leave you lost, a riddle. "Nah, so?" (なぞ)
Thread (糸) radical: a string or cord. "He moves" it with a string: ひも.
Earth (土) radical: dust. "Ho, Cory!" Cory sneezes in the dust (ほこり).
Head (頁) radical: your cheeks. "Ho ho!" (ほほ) says Santa with round red cheeks.
Head (頁) radical: your cheeks. "Oh!" (ほお) you say, hands on your cheeks.
Altar (礻) + single (単): one quiet mind at the altar, Zen (ぜん).
Flesh (月) radical: a thin skin in the body, like the film you peel off a new "Mac" (まく) screen.
Flesh (月) radical: the thigh, where your legs split apart like a fork (また).
A tongue sticking out of a mouth (口); it sits "shita" (下, below) your nose.
Body (尸) radical: your bottom. Falling on it looks "silly" (しり).
Sake jar (酉) radical: drink gone sour turns into vinegar. "Sue!" (す) it's sour!
Black (黒) over earth (土): black ink made from soot. "Sue me" (すみ) for spilling it.
或 means a certain: 或る日 is "one day", some certain day in a story.
Water (氵) + wrap (包): water wrapped around air, a bubble. "Ah, wow!" (あわ)
Field (田) over flesh (月): the body part full of food, your stomach. "Eee!" (い) it hurts.
Food (食) radical: food you put out as bait. "Eh, sir" (えさ), feed the fish.
貝 is a picture of a shell. Shells were old money, so 貝 shows up in money kanji.
Shell or husk; から also means empty (空), like a shell with nothing inside.
Water (氵) radical: a big river, read かわ like 川 but bigger.
Metal (金) radical: a metal chain. "Coo, sorry" (くさり), you're chained up.
Lord (君) + village (阝): the land a lord rules, a district.
Stone (石) radical: the board game played with black and white stones, Go (ご).
Jewels (王王) on top: a fine harp, the koto (こと).
Words (言) radical: a saying. ことわざ is word (こと) + skill (わざ): skillful words.
Earth (土) under a deer (鹿): dust kicked up, rubbish. "Go, me!" (ごみ) taking out the trash.
Grass (艹) radical: a sprout poking up from the soil, like a little eye (目, め) opening.
Woman (女) + house (家): the woman who joins your house, a bride.
Water (氵) radical: water inside a bend of the coast, a bay. "One" (わん) big bay.
Wood (木) radical: a wooden bowl for miso soup. "One" (わん) bowl, please.
Rice (米) radical: pure like polished white rice; a stylish person is "eek, cool" (いき).
Water (氵) radical: water spinning in a swirl. Goo "oozes" (うず) round the drain.
Body (尸) + hair (毛): hair at the end of the body, a tail.
Tree (木) radical: the hard kernel inside a fruit, the core or nucleus.
Sickness (疒) + rocks (嵒): a hard lump of sickness, cancer.
Lord (君) + sheep (羊): sheep crowd around their leader, a group.
"Ta-da!" (ただ) it's free, only for you.
Feathers (羽) on top: wings. "Tsu-basa" flaps her wings (つばさ).
Earth (土) radical: a tall tower or pagoda; とう sounds like "tower".
Tiger (虍) radical: a tiger. "Tora!" (とら) roars the tiger.
A picture of a mouse with teeth and tail; its "nez" (nose) twitches: ねずみ.
Earth (土) under a setting sun in grass (莫): earth where life ends, a grave.
A flag flapping "hata hata" (はた) in the wind.
Clothes (衤) + fruit (果): peeled like fruit, no clothes, your skin (肌, はだ) shows.
Earth (土) radical: an earth wall or fence. "Hey!" (へい) you shout over it.
Fire (火) on fire (火): a big flame. "Oh no!" (ほのお)
Water (氵) radical: a ditch dug (掘る, ほる) around a castle and filled with water, a moat.
Tree (木) + 冊 (slats tied in a row): wooden slats in a line, a fence.
Blood (血) over people: crowds of people, the masses.
Flesh (月) + good (善): good food on a small tray, a meal.
A shield stands upright (縦, たて, vertical) in front of you.
Rain (雨) + road (路): drops on the road in the morning, dew.
Tree (木) + east (東): the wooden ridge beam on top of a roof.
Flesh (月) radical: the lungs. Take a deep breath and say "Hi!" (はい).
Stone (石) radical: a stone with writing on it, a monument. "He" (ひ) is remembered there.
Tree (木) radical: a wooden frame. "Walk" (わく) inside the frame.
冷 means cold: leave hot tea so it cools; 冷ます is to let it cool.
覚 means wake or remember: 目を覚ます, to wake someone (or yourself) up.
冷 means cold: soup left out becomes cool; feelings can cool off too.
Support (支) + pay (払う): to pay a bill or fee.
占 means occupy: to take up space, or take up a share of the total.
Water (氵) radical: to become damp. "She melts" (しめる) in the damp heat.
生 means life or birth: something is born, it arises or occurs.
Person (亻) + word (言): a person whose word you trust, to believe.
優 means excellent: to be better than others, to excel.
Power (力) radical: give someone a push forward, to recommend or urge.
Water (氵) radical: water becomes clear. Same sound as 住む (live), different meaning.
Water (氵) + blue (青): clear blue water, to become clear.
Knife (刂) radical: old printing used carved blocks, to print.
為 means do or for the sake of: it is just する (to do) written in kanji.
Words (言) + emperor (帝): when the emperor speaks, you give up arguing.
Food (食) radical: eat the same food too often and you get tired of it.
Hand (扌) radical: to lift up; also to deep-fry, like 唐揚げ (からあげ).
Hand (手) at the bottom: raise your hand to give examples.
Sun (日) radical: the sun warms the room up.
Water (氵) radical: warm water warms you up, like a hot bath.
Sun (日) radical: to warm something, like the sun heats the air.
Hand (扌) radical: things you handle with your hands, to treat or deal with.
当 means hit or right: to hit the target, or put something against it.
著 means author (著者): to write and publish a book.
現 means present or real (現在): to appear, to show up for real.
在 means exist (存在), 有 means have (有名): both read ある, to be or have.
Heart (忄) + wild (荒): a wild heart, to panic.
Hand (扌) + wrap (包): hands wrap around it, to hold, or to hold a feeling inside.
Heavy (重) + power (力): use power to move heavy things.
Words (言) + hand (寸): fight with words and hands, to attack or take revenge.
Hand (手) at the bottom: pull the trigger, to shoot.
写 means copy (写真, photo): your image is copied into the photo.
Chase (追う) + stick to (付く): chase until you are right behind, to catch up.
Heart (心) radical: answer from the heart, to respond or comply.
覀 (cover) on top: put a cover over it, to cover or hide.
Money (貝) radical: send something valuable, to give a present.
Push (押す) with your hand: push down and hold, to restrain.
収 means collect (収入, income): collect things and put them away.
Thread (糸) + inside (内): put things inside, to store, or to pay (taxes).
Water (氵) radical: control the rivers and you govern the land.
教 means teach: 教える is to teach, 教わる is to be taught.
Few (少) + power (力): less power, to be worse than others.
Water (氵) + weak (弱): weak in the water, to drown.
Hang (掛かる) on someone's eyes (目): come into their sight, polite "to meet".
A thought (思い) sticks (付く): an idea comes to you.
及 means reach: let your effect reach others, to cause or exert.
降 means go down (降りる): to bring something or someone down.
Sell goods down to shops, wholesale; also to grate, like 大根おろし.
帰 means return (帰る): to send someone back home.
Person (亻) radical: one person takes another's place, to substitute.
反 means against or reverse: wood bends back the other way, to warp.
Hand (扌) + wrap (包): wrap your arms around it, to carry in your arms.
Light (光) + army (軍): an army's shining armor, to shine and sparkle.
Net (罒) radical: caught in the net of a sickness, to catch an illness.
Hand (扌) radical: use your nails, to scratch.
Mouth (口) + smell (臭): use your nose, to sniff.
Hill (阝) radical: hide behind a hill, to be hidden.
欠 means lack (欠席, absence): something is missing or chipped.
Enclosure (囗) radical: draw a box around it, to surround.
重 means heavy or layer: things lie on top of each other.
重 means layer: you put one thing on top of another.
Grain (禾) + house (家): grow grain for your house, to earn a living.
数 means number (数学, math): to count.
Not (非) + heart (心): a heart saying no, to be sad.
Clothes (衤) + skin (皮): cover your skin, to wear a hat; also to be covered with.
Knife (刂) radical: cut grass or hair with a blade.
乾 means dry (乾燥): to make something dry.
Water (氵) radical: you have no water, your throat is dry and thirsty.
Person (亻) radical: one person takes another's place.
Mind (気) + stick (付く): it sticks in your mind, you notice.
It enters (入る) your mind (気): you like it.
嫌 means dislike (嫌い): 嫌う is the verb, to hate.
Meat (肉) in a storehouse (府): meat left in storage goes bad.
Thread (糸) radical: tie threads together, to put together or team up (組, group).
Water (氵) radical: to scoop up water.
Sake jar (酉) + ladle (勺): ladle out sake, to pour it for someone.
Dog (犭) + king (王): a dog acting like a king has gone crazy.
Power (力) + mouth (口): add your voice and your strength, to add.
Mouth (口) radical: to hold something in your mouth.
Foot (足) radical: use your foot, to kick.
Ice (冫) radical: water turns to ice (氷, こおり), to freeze.
Run (走) radical: run past it, to go over or beyond.
Woman (女) + child (子): what you love most, to like or prefer.
殺 means kill (殺人, murder): to kill.
Vehicle (車) radical: wheels roll over, and so do you, to fall down.
Road (辶) radical: walking the wrong way down the road, to go against.
Clothes (衣) at the bottom: tear the cloth, to split.
Knife (刂) radical: something sharp gets stuck in.
Knife (刂) radical: stab or sting with a sharp point.
Hand (扌) radical: put in with your hand, like flowers in a vase.
Water (氵) radical: pour a liquid in, like drops or a drink.
射 means shoot (arrows): light shoots in, to shine.
Water (氵) radical: water fills to the top, to be full.
Words (言) radical: a doctor looks and asks questions, to examine a patient.
Knife (刂) radical: use a knife to peel the skin.
Grass (艹) on top, fire (灬) below: cook food in steam over a fire.
命 means order or life (命令, command): to command.
Hold (持つ) + raise (上げる): hold it and lift it up.
用 means use (用事, errand): to make use of.
Fire (火) radical: to make something burn.
Door (戸) radical: bring someone in your door to work, to hire.
Stone (石) + skin (皮): a stone tears the skin, to get torn.
Words (言) radical: politely give way, like handing over your seat.
Grass (艹) radical: boil vegetables in hot water. "You'd" (ゆで) boil them.
Sake jar (酉) radical: too much drink, you get drunk.
Side (横) + cut (切る): cut across sideways, to cross.
Water (氵) radical: dirty water, to make something dirty.
寄 means come near (寄る): bring things close together.
Words (言) radical: put your words in order, to argue or discuss.
分 means divide: the road divides, to branch off.
Water (氵) + brave (勇): water bravely springs up from the ground, to well up. (Boil is 沸く.)
当 means hit: a hit, when you hit the mark.
宛 is used in 宛先 (address): write who a letter is for.
傷 means wound (傷, きず): to hurt or damage.
Fire (火) + little (少): quick cooking over a fire, to stir-fry.
Earth (土) radical: covered with earth, to be buried or filled.
産 means birth or produce (生産): to give birth.
A person (⺈) carrying money (貝): carry a debt, to bear or owe.
Horse (馬) radical: run fast like a horse.
Money (貝) radical: put money on it, to bet.
Bamboo (竹) radical: build with bamboo and wood, to build.
攻 means attack (攻撃): to attack.
責 means blame or duty (責任): to blame.
Person (亻) radical: a person gets ready, to prepare.
具 means tool (道具): to be equipped with tools.
Hand (扌) + front (前): line things up in front of you, to be complete or match.
Person (亻) + arrive (到): to knock a person down.
Fire (火) radical: cook rice over the fire (炊飯器, rice cooker).
Woods (林) over fire (火): burn wood, to build a fire.
Hand (扌) + wrap (包): wrap someone in your arms, to hug.
戦 means war (戦争): to fight.
Stand (立つ) + go up (上がる): to stand up.
建 means build (建物, building): a building stands.
Horse (馬) radical: like the Trojan horse, to trick someone.
